name: Delaware
rateNote: No statutory interest rate — deed state with short redemption window
bidMethod: Premium bid (highest dollar) — sheriff conducts sale
auctionPlatform: Sheriff-run — 3 counties only (Kent, New Castle, Sussex)
keyNotes: Only 3 counties hold tax deed sales — very low inventory state
Sheriff conducts all sales — not county treasurer
Standard redemption: 60 days after court approval of sale
Alternative procedure available with 1-year redemption — Del. Code tit. 9 §8771
Dept. of Finance must approve final bid before redemption clock starts
summary: Delaware has only 3 counties (Kent, New Castle, Sussex), each running independent auctions. Inventory is very limited. Statute: Del. Code Title 9 §8721.
typeWhy: Delaware sells the property deed at auction but grants the original owner a redemption window of 60 days to 1 year depending on the county, making it a redeemable deed state. Del. Code Title 9 §8721.
rateWhy: Delaware counties impose a 15-20% penalty on redemption, varying by county. With only 3 counties (Kent, New Castle, Sussex), each sets its own penalty structure. Del. Code Title 9 §8721.
notBeginnerReason: Only 3 counties, very limited inventory, not a viable primary market.
beginnerTip: Delaware works best as a supplemental state, not a primary market. If you're already working the Mid-Atlantic region, add it to your list.
risks: Low auction activity makes this an unreliable primary strategy
Competitive in New Castle County (Wilmington area)
ddExtra: Verify the exact redemption period for your county — it ranges 60 days to 1 year
Check for Wilmington city-specific tax liens which operate separately from New Castle County

steps: Contact the specific county's finance office — New Castle: newcastlede.gov, Kent: co.kent.de.us, Sussex: sussexcountyde.gov
Request the upcoming tax sale schedule and delinquent property list
Register with the county per their instructions
Attend the auction — most are in-person

stateStructure.note: Delaware has only 3 counties. Each county independently handles tax sales via 'Monition' (judicial notice/writ) process through Superior Court. Sheriff conducts sale.
stateStructure.uniqueFeature: Monition = formal legal notice served on property + published. Superior Court must approve all sales.
stateStructure.monitionMethod: Subchapter II — Superior Court judicial process used for tax sales in all 3 counties

auction.frequency: As scheduled — no fixed statewide date
auction.method: Public auction by Sheriff — highest bidder

payment.sussex: 20% deposit day of sale; balance by 3PM; 100% full payment for monition/tax sales

auction.approval: Superior Court must confirm all sales (9 Del. C. §8726)

otc.name: N/A — Delaware judicial sale process only. Contact county finance offices for any surplus county-owned property.

deedPath.name: Sheriff's Deed (after Superior Court confirmation)
deedPath.process: Sale → Superior Court confirms → Sheriff delivers certificate → deed after redemption period expires
deedPath.titleQuality: Free and clear of all liens held by parties given notice in proceedings

surplus.name: Surplus Proceeds
surplus.process: Superior Court handles distribution of surplus after all tax obligations paid
surplus.note: Tyler v. Hennepin applies — DE judicial process routes surplus via court to former owners

es.summary: Delaware tiene solo 3 condados (Kent, New Castle, Sussex), cada uno realizando subastas independientes. Estatuto: Del. Code Título 9 §8721.
es.typeWhy: Delaware es un estado de escritura redimible porque los condados venden la propiedad en subasta fiscal, pero el propietario original retiene un derecho de redención que varía de 60 días a 1 año según el condado (Del. Code Título 9 §8721).
es.rateWhy: La penalización del 15-20% varía por condado. Cada uno de los 3 condados establece su propia estructura de penalización dentro de ese rango estatutario (Del. Code Título 9 §8721).
es.notBeginnerReason: Solo 3 condados, inventario muy limitado, no es un mercado primario viable.
es.beginnerTip: Delaware funciona mejor como estado suplementario, no como mercado primario.
risks: Bajo flujo de operaciones hace esto poco confiable
Competitivo en New Castle (área de Wilmington)
ddExtra: Verifique el período de redención exacto — varía de 60 días a 1 año
Revise gravámenes fiscales específicos de Wilmington que operan por separado

steps: Contacte la oficina de finanzas del condado — New Castle: newcastlede.gov, Kent: co.kent.de.us, Sussex: sussexcountyde.gov
Solicite el calendario de venta fiscal próximo y lista de propiedades en mora
Regístrese con el condado según sus instrucciones
Asista a la subasta — la mayoría son en persona
